an6.54:1.1: 54 ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati gijjhakūṭe pabbate.
an6.54:1.2: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā dhammiko jātibhūmiyaṃ āvāsiko hoti sabbaso jātibhūmiyaṃ sattasu āvāsesu.
an6.54:1.3: tatra sudaṃ āyasmā dhammako āgantuke bhikkhū akkosati paribhāsati vihiṃsati vitudati roseti vācāya
an6.54:1.4: te ca āgantukā bhikkhū āyasmatā dhammikena akkosiyamānā paribhāsiyamānā vihesiyamānā vitudiyamānā rosiyamānā vācāya pakkamanti na saṇṭhanti riñcanti āvāsaṃ.
an6.54:2.3: atha ca pana āgantukā bhikkhū pakkamanti na saṇṭhanti riñcanti āvāsaṃ
an6.54:2.4: ko nukho hetu ko paccayo yena āgantukā bhikkhū pakkamanti na saṇṭhanti riñcanti āvāsanti.
an6.54:2.6: ayaṃ kho āyasmā dhammiko āgantuke bhikkhū akkosati paribhāsati vihiṃsati vitudati roseti vācāya
an6.54:2.7: te ca āgantukā bhikkhū āyasmatā dhammikena akkosiyamānā paribhāsiyamānā vihesiyamānā vitudiyamānā rosiyamānā vācāya pakkamanti na saṇṭhanti riñcanti āvāsaṃ.
an6.54:3.1: atha kho jātibhūmikā upāsakā yena āyasmā dhammiko tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ dhammikaṃ etadavocuṃ
an6.54:3.2: pakkamatu bhante āyasmā dhammiko imamhā āvāsā
an6.54:3.4: atha kho āyasmā dhammiko tamhā āvāsā aññaṃ āvāsaṃ agamāsi.
an6.54:3.5: tatrapi sudaṃ āyasmā dhammiko āgantuke bhikkhū akkosati paribhāsati vihiṃsati vitudati roseti vācāya
an6.54:3.6: te ca āgantukā bhikkhū āyasmatā dhammikena akkosiyamānā paribhāsiyamānā vihesiyamānā vitudiyamānā rosiyamānā vācāya pakkamanti na saṇṭhanti riñcanti āvāsaṃ.
an6.54:4.3: atha ca pana āgantukā bhikkhū pakkamanti na saṇṭhanti riñcanti āvāsaṃ
an6.54:4.4: ko nu kho hetu ko paccayo yena āgantukā bhikkhū pakkamanti na saṇṭhanti riñcanti āvāsanti.
an6.54:4.6: ayaṃ kho āyasmā dhammiko āgantuke bhikkhū akkosati paribhāsati vihiṃsati vitudati roseti vācāya
an6.54:4.7: te ca āgantukā bhikkhū āyasmatā dhammikena akkosiyamānā paribhāsiyamānā vihesiyamānā vitudiyamānā rosiyamānā vācāya pakkamanti na saṇṭhanti riñcanti āvāsaṃ.
an6.54:5.1: atha kho jātibhūmikā upāsakā yena āyasmā dhammiko tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ dhammikaṃ etadavocuṃ
an6.54:5.2: pakkamatu bhante āyasmā dhammiko imamhāpi āvāsā
an6.54:5.4: atha kho āyasmā dhammiko tamhāpi āvāsā aññaṃ āvāsaṃ agamāsi.
an6.54:5.5: tatrapi sudaṃ āyasmā dhammiko āgantuke bhikkhū akkosati paribhāsati vihiṃsati vitudati roseti vācāya
an6.54:5.6: te ca āgantukā bhikkhū āyasmatā dhammikena akkosiyamānā paribhāsiyamānā vihesiyamānā vitudiyamānā rosiyamānā vācāya pakkamanti na saṇṭhanti riñcanti āvāsaṃ.
an6.54:6.3: atha ca pana āgantukā bhikkhū pakkamanti na saṇṭhanti riñcanti āvāsaṃ
an6.54:6.4: ko nu kho hetu ko paccayo yena āgantukā bhikkhū pakkamanti na saṇṭhanti riñcanti āvāsanti.
an6.54:6.6: yannūna mayaṃ āyasmantaṃ dhammikaṃ pabbājeyyāma sabbaso jātibhūmiyaṃ sattahi āvāsehīti.
an6.54:6.7: atha kho jātibhūmikā upāsakā yena āyasmā dhammiko tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ dhammikaṃ etadavocuṃ
an6.54:6.8: pakkamatu bhante āyasmā dhammiko sabbaso jātibhūmiyaṃ sattahi āvāsehīti.
an6.54:6.10: pabbājito khomhi jātibhūmikehi upāsakehi sabbaso jātibhūmiyaṃ sattahi āvāsehi
an6.54:7.1: atha kho āyasmā dhammiko pattacīvaramādāya yena rājagahaṃ tena pakkāmi
an6.54:7.2: anupubbena yena rājagahaṃ gijjhakūṭo pabbato yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ dhammikaṃ bhagavā etadavoca
an6.54:7.3: handa kuto nu tvaṃ brāhmaṇa dhammika āgacchasīti.
an6.54:7.4: pabbājito ahaṃ bhante jātibhūmikehi upāsakehi sabbaso jātibhūmiyaṃ sattahi āvāsehīti.
an6.54:7.5: alaṃ brāhmaṇa dhammika kinte iminā yantaṃ tato tato pabbājenti so tvaṃ tato tato pabbājito mameva santike āgacchasi.
an6.54:8.1: bhūtapubbaṃ brāhmaṇa dhammika sāmuddikā vāṇijā tīradassiṃ sakuṇaṃ gahetvā nāvāya samuddaṃ ajjhogāhanti
an6.54:8.2: te atīradassaniyā nāvāya tīradassiṃ sakuṇaṃ muñcanti
an6.54:8.3: so gacchateva puratthimaṃ disaṃ gacchati pacchimaṃ disaṃ gacchati uttaraṃ disaṃ gacchati dakkhiṇaṃ disaṃ gacchati uddhaṃ gacchati anudisaṃ
an6.54:8.4: sace so samantā tīraṃ passati tathāgatakova hoti
an6.54:8.5: sace pana so samantā tīraṃ na passati tameva nāvaṃ paccāgacchati
an6.54:8.6: evameva kho brāhmaṇa dhammika yantaṃ tato tato pabbājenti so tvaṃ tato tato pabbājito mameva santike āgacchasi.
an6.54:9.1: bhūtapubbaṃ brāhmaṇa dhammika rañño korabyassa suppatiṭṭho nāma nigrodharājā ahosi pañcasākho sītacchāyo manoramo
an6.54:9.2: suppatiṭṭhassa kho pana brāhmaṇa dhammika nigrodharājassa dvādasa yojanāni abhiniveso ahosi pañca yojanāni mūlasantānakānaṃ
an6.54:9.3: suppatiṭṭhassa kho pana brāhmaṇa dhammika nigrodharājassa mahantāni phalāni ahesuṃ
an6.54:9.7: suppatiṭṭhassa kho pana brāhmaṇa dhammika nigrodharājassa ekaṃ khandhaṃ rājā paribhuñjati saddhiṃ itthāgārena ekaṃ khandhaṃ balakāyo paribhuñjati ekaṃ khandhaṃ negamajānapadā paribhuñjanti ekaṃ khandhaṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇā paribhuñjanti ekaṃ khandhaṃ migapakkhino paribhuñjanti
an6.54:9.8: suppatiṭṭhassa kho pana brāhmaṇa dhammika nigrodharājassa na koci phalāni rakkhati na ca sudaṃ aññamaññassa phalāni hiṃsanti
an6.54:10.1: atha kho brāhmaṇa dhammika aññataro puriso suppatiṭṭhassa nigrodharājassa yāvadatthaṃ phalāni bhakkhitvā sākhaṃ bhañjitvā pakkāmi
an6.54:10.2: atha kho brāhmaṇa dhammika suppatiṭṭhe nigrodharāje adhivatthāya devatāya etadahosi
an6.54:10.3: acchariyaṃ vata bho abbhutaṃ vata bho
an6.54:10.4: yāva pāpamanusso yatra hi nāma suppatiṭṭhassa nigrodharājassa yāvadatthaṃ phalāni bhakkhitvā sākhaṃ bhañjitvā pakkamissati yannūna suppatiṭṭho nigrodharājā āyatiṃ phalaṃ na dadeyyāti
an6.54:10.5: atha kho brāhmaṇa dhammika suppatiṭṭho nigrodharājā āyatiṃ phalaṃ na adāsi
an6.54:11.1: atha kho brāhmaṇa dhammika rājā korabyo yena sakko devānamindo tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā sakkaṃ devānamindaṃ etadavoca
an6.54:11.2: yagghe mārisa jāneyyāsi suppatiṭṭho nigrodharājā phalaṃ na detīti
an6.54:11.3: atha kho brāhmaṇa dhammika sakko devānamindo tathārūpaṃ iddhābhisaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṃkhāresi yathā bhūsā vātavuṭṭhi āgantvā suppatiṭṭhaṃ nigrodharājaṃ pavattesi ummūlamakāsi
an6.54:11.4: atha kho brāhmaṇa dhammika suppatiṭṭhe nigrodharāje adhivatthā devatā dukkhī dummanā assumukhī rudamānā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi
an6.54:12.1: atha kho brāhmaṇa dhammika sakko devānamindo yena suppatiṭṭhe nigrodharāje adhivatthā devatā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā suppatiṭṭhe nigrodharāje adhivatthaṃ devataṃ etadavoca
an6.54:12.2: kiṃ nu tvaṃ devate dukkhī dummanā assumukhī rudamānā ekamantaṃ ṭhitāti
an6.54:12.3: tathā hi pana me mārisa bhūsā vātavuṭṭhi āgantvā bhavanaṃ pavattesi ummūlamakāsīti
an6.54:12.4: api nu tvaṃ devate rukkhadhamme ṭhitā bhūsā vātavuṭṭhi āgantvā bhavanaṃ pavattesi ummūlamakāsīti
an6.54:12.5: kathaṃ pana mārisa rukkho rukkhadhamme ṭhito hotīti
an6.54:12.6: idha devate rukkhassa mūlaṃ mūlatthikā haranti tacaṃ tacatthikā haranti pattaṃ pattatthikā haranti pupphaṃ pupphatthikā haranti phalaṃ phalatthikā haranti
an6.54:12.7: na ca tena devatāya anattamanatā vā anabhinandi vā karaṇīyā
an6.54:12.8: evaṃ kho devate rukkho rukkhadhamme ṭhito hotīti
an6.54:12.9: aṭṭhitā yeva kho me mārisa rukkhadhamme bhūsā vātavuṭṭhi āgantvā bhavanaṃ pavattesi ummūlamakāsīti
an6.54:12.10: sace kho tvaṃ devate rukkhadhamme tiṭṭheyyāsi siyā te bhavanaṃ yathā pureti
an6.54:12.11: tiṭṭheyyāmahaṃ mārisa rukkhadhamme hotu me bhavanaṃ yathā pureti
an6.54:13.1: atha kho brāhmaṇa dhammika sakko devānamindo tathārūpaṃ iddhābhisaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṃkhāri yathā bhūsā vātavuṭṭhi āgantvā suppatiṭṭhaṃ nigrodharājaṃ ussāpeti sacchavīni mūlāni ahesuṃ
an6.54:13.2: evameva kho brāhmaṇa dhammika apinu taṃ samaṇadhamme ṭhitaṃ jātibhūmikā upāsakā pabbājesuṃ sabbaso jātibhūmiyaṃ sattahi āvāsehīti
an6.54:13.3: kathaṃ pana bhante samaṇo samaṇadhamme ṭhito hotīti
an6.54:13.4: idha brāhmaṇa dhammika samaṇo akkosantaṃ na paccakkosati rosantaṃ na paṭirosati bhaṇḍantaṃ na pibhaṇḍati
an6.54:13.5: evaṃ kho brāhmaṇa dhammika samaṇo samaṇadhamme ṭhito hotīti
an6.54:13.6: aṭṭhitaññeva kho maṃ bhante samaṇadhamme jātibhūmikā upāsakā pabbājesuṃ sabbaso jātibhūmiyaṃ sattahi āvāsehīti.
an6.54:13.7: bhūtapubbaṃ brāhmaṇa dhammika sunetto nāma satthā ahosi titthakaro kāmesu vītarāgo
an6.54:13.8: sunettassa kho pana brāhmaṇa dhammika satthuno anekāni sāvakasatāni ahesuṃ
an6.54:13.9: sunetto satthā sāvakānaṃ brahmalokasahabyatāya dhammaṃ desesi
an6.54:13.10: ye kho pana brāhmaṇa dhammika sunettassa satthuno brahmalokasahabyatāya dhammaṃ desentassa cittāni na pasādesuṃ te kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjiṃsu
an6.54:13.11: ye kho pana brāhmaṇa dhammika sunettassa satthuno brahmalokasahabyatāya dhammaṃ desentassa cittāni pasādesuṃ te kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjiṃsu.
an6.54:14.1: bhūtapubbaṃ brāhmaṇa dhammika mūgapakkho nāma satthā ahosi …pe…
an6.54:18.1: jotipālo nāma satthā ahosi titthakaro kāmesu vītarāgo
an6.54:18.2: jotipālassa kho pana brāhmaṇa dhammika satthuno anekāni sāvakasatāni ahesuṃ
an6.54:18.3: jotipālo satthā sāvakānaṃ brahmalokasahabyatāya dhammaṃ desesi
an6.54:18.4: ye kho pana brāhmaṇa dhammika jotipālassa satthuno brahmalokasahabyatāya dhammaṃ desentassa cittāni na pasādesuṃ te kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjiṃsu
an6.54:18.5: ye kho pana brāhmaṇa dhammika jotipālassa satthuno brahmalokasahabyatāya dhammaṃ desentassa cittāni pasādesuṃ te kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjiṃsu.
an6.54:19.2: yo ime cha satthāro titthakare kāmesu vītarāge anekasataparivāre sasāvakasaṅghe paduṭṭhaṭhitto akkoseyya paribhāseyya bahuṃ so apuññaṃ pasaveyyāti.
an6.54:19.4: yo kho brāhmaṇa dhammika ime cha satthāro titthakare kāmesu vītarāge anekasataparivāre sasāvakasaṅghe paduṭṭhacitto akkoseyya paribhāseyya bahuṃ so apuññaṃ pasaveyya
an6.54:19.5: yo ekaṃ diṭṭhisampannaṃ puggalaṃ paduṭṭhacitto akkosati paribhāsati ayaṃ tato bahutaraṃ apuññaṃ pasavati
an6.54:19.7: nāhaṃ brāhmaṇa dhammika ito bahiddhā evarūpaṃ khantaṃ vadāmi yathā maṃ sabrahmacārīsu
an6.54:19.8: tasmā tiha brāhmaṇa dhammika evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ
an6.54:19.9: na no āmasabrahmacārīsu cittāni paduṭṭhāni bhavissantīti
an6.54:19.10: evaṃ hi te brāhmaṇa dhammika sikkhitabbanti.
